shared_file_insertions.inserted_text: **连续推进部分接合与接口重建 / Partial joining and reconstructed interfaces, 8 October 2026.** [新整合](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-JOINING-INTEGRATION.md)新增 **54项 Lean 定理（23＋31）／128项含继承审计**：接合探针恢复接口和可接合性；三元关系唯一确定局部单位，有限轨迹的状态接口可全部恢复。匹配单位不保证容量足够，反例与完整接续判准均已查。 / Audits: 105 empty, 23 standard propext only. The established relational/object-free route is credited. Next examine supported tests for definedness and output distinctions with shared-capacity and concurrent conflicts; universal priority remains open.

**从接合恢复接口 / Recovering interfaces from joining, 8 October 2026.** [连续两层](unified-2026-10-05/EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY.md#32-把能否接合纳入结构本身)新增54项 Lean 定理：空历史探针恢复端点，部分接合关系唯一确定起止单位；完整轨迹中的整个状态接口集合可恢复。容量反例阻止普遍套用“单位匹配就能实现”。 / A checked completion criterion states the additional condition. The relational/category precedent, inaccessible-test limit and internal-word counterexample remain explicit.

**Successive joining investigation, 8 October 2026.** [Ren’s exact continuation](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-generative-explanatory-necessity.md#连续推进--continue-and-continue) is recorded separately from AI results. [Primary comparison](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-JOINING-INTEGRATION.md#8-primary-source-assessment-and-genealogy) reads Cranch–Doherty–Struth’s ternary relations, units, coherence and separating examples, including the same two-element partial-budget shape. The HTML fetch failed; the named PDF sections were read. Link-only preservation, no mathematical novelty or independent-agent claim.

**Partial realization → recovered interfaces → conditional completion, 8 October 2026.** [The two-stage study](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-JOINING-INTEGRATION.md) adds 54 checked theorems / 128 audits (105 empty, 23 propext only). Empty-history probes recover endpoint interfaces and joinability; the partial ternary relation uniquely determines local-unit roles. Full finite traces recover their supplied state interfaces, while a capacity-limited partial monoid defeats unconditional matching-unit sufficiency. Chain completion is characterized separately, not assumed as universal. The factual contribution concerns adequate conditions for joint realization; no normative warrant or unique ontology follows. Next retain shared-capacity/concurrent conflicts and actual probe availability when recovering product distinctions.

C30.title_zh: 生成关系的解释必要性
C30.claim_zh: 固定接续问题迫出共同最小组合结构；进一步从原有取得、错误、审查与接续问题说明解释须保留哪些相关关系。准确原生边界答案迫出同一中间边界的接合；同一规律下的历史、后续及失败区别不可任意合并。整体或非时间式说明仍合格。
C30.claim_en: Fixed contextual questions force a common minimal composition structure. Native acquisition, error, review and continuation questions further motivate relevant preservation: exact boundary answers inherit joining through one intermediate boundary, and same-law history, continuation and failure distinctions cannot be erased. Global or atemporal accounts remain eligible.
C30.scope_zh: 此前17、45、40、32及36项研究保留原范围。新增42项定理／64项新审计全部空依赖；248项继承审计原样保留（194空、54标准依赖）。独立审查接受必要保真判准及有条件证明；规律与真实对应仍明示，非完整解释充分性或普遍无假设根基。下一检验以实际取得／运用证据区分共同原因或预设序列对手。
C30.scope_en: Prior 17-, 45-, 40-, 32- and 36-theorem studies retain scope. New 42 theorems / 64 audits are empty; 248 inherited maps unchanged (194 empty, 54 standard). Independent review accepts necessary fidelity and conditional proofs, with native law and correspondence explicit. This does not establish explanatory sufficiency or universal assumption-free grounding. Next test acquisition/use evidence against common-cause or predetermined-sequence rivals.

F22.title_zh: 关系恢复、证据再用与组合结构唯一性
F22.title_en: Relation recovery, evidence reuse and compositional uniqueness
F22.claim_zh: 保留必要内容、校准、整体对手与上下文组合证明；新增准确表述的原生接合与可替换性、可能／完成／分支接续区别，并在未经改写的同一模型中实查历史遗失、当下相同而后续不同、耗尽／关闭及纠正后错误回归。
F22.claim_en: Retains necessary-content, calibration, global-rival and contextual-composition proofs; adds exact-account native joining/substitution, distinctions between possibility, completed outcomes and branch continuation, and same-law witnesses of lost history, equal presents with different futures, exhaustion/closure and error returning after correction.
F22.scope_zh: 前轮36项新定理／110项审计的范围及77空、30仅propext、3另含Quot.sound依赖保留。本轮42项新定理／64项新审计全部空；另248项继承审计逐项不变（194空、54标准）。两轮继承重叠不累加。完整11模块实查、独立审查通过；局部规律、观察问题与准确性条件不是无前提所得。
F22.scope_en: Earlier 36 new theorems / 110 audits retain their 77 empty, 30 propext-only and 3 additional Quot.sound scope. This round: 42 new theorems / 64 empty audits; 248 inherited maps unchanged (194 empty, 54 standard). Overlapping closures are not added together. All 11 modules checked and independently reviewed; native law, observation questions and exactness remain explicit inputs.

C30.title_zh: 生成关系的解释必要性
C30.claim_zh: 独立指定的取得、错误与后续问题要求保留实际差异和共同边界；接合探针进一步恢复有限片段接口，三元关系唯一确定局部单位，完整有限轨迹恢复其状态接口。整体表述仍合格，容量反例限定接口匹配的充分性。
C30.claim_en: Independently specified acquisition, error and continuation questions require native distinctions and shared boundaries. Joining probes further recover finite-fragment interfaces; the ternary relation determines unique unit roles, and complete finite traces recover their state interfaces. Global accounts remain eligible; capacity limits matching-unit sufficiency.
C30.scope_zh: 此前各轮及实际展开42项定理／64项新审计保留原范围与独立评审；本轮另54项（23＋31）／128项含继承审计：105空、23仅propext。探针可用性、状态内容及完整接续条件明示；共享容量／并行冲突下的定义域与输出识别仍待推进。
C30.scope_en: Earlier studies, including native unfolding (42 theorems / 64 new audits and its independent review), retain their scopes. This separate 54 (23+31) / 128 audit study has 105 empty and 23 propext-only lists. Probe access, state content and completion are explicit; identification with shared-capacity/concurrent conflicts remains open.

F22.title_zh: 关系恢复、组合唯一性与接口重建
F22.title_en: Relation recovery, composition uniqueness and reconstructed interfaces
F22.claim_zh: 继承校准、结构对手、组合唯一性及实际展开的接合／替换、分支继续与同规律错误反例；另增空历史探针、局部单位唯一性与关系同构下保持、完整接续充要条件和整个状态接口恢复。容量及内部序列丢失反例保留。
F22.claim_en: Retains calibration, structural rivals, compositional uniqueness and native unfolding’s joining/substitution, branch-continuation distinctions and same-law error cases. Adds empty-history probes, unique units and transport, an exact completion criterion and state-interface recovery, retaining capacity and internal-word-loss counters.
F22.scope_zh: 实际展开42项定理／64项新审计与该研究继承248项审计保持原范围；本轮23＋31项新定理，另74项继承审计，共128项：105空、23仅propext。新54项中43空、11仅propext，无自定公理。数学恢复不等于物理取得或唯一基础。
F22.scope_en: Native unfolding retains its 42 theorems / 64 new and 248 inherited audits. This study adds 23+31 theorems with 74 inherited audits: 128 total, 105 empty and 23 propext only; new 54 comprise 43 empty and 11 propext only. No custom axioms. Recovery is not acquisition or unique grounding.
